name: EasyLead – Popup Contact & Lead Forms
author: softsguad

sections.description:
EasyLead is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress plugin for collecting customer inquiries through modern popup forms.

Whether you need a simple contact popup or an advanced multistep lead form, EasyLead gives you complete flexibility. Build a basic contact form in minutes or create a guided, step-by-step experience that helps visitors provide all the information you need before submitting an inquiry.

Every submission is automatically stored in your WordPress dashboard, and you receive an email notification whenever a new inquiry arrives.

Two Ways to Collect Leads

Simple Popup Contact Forms

Create a classic popup contact form using your own fields.

Perfect for:

  • Contact requests
  • Quote requests
  • Consultation requests
  • General inquiries
  • Customer support

Add fields like:

  • Name
  • Email
  • Phone number
  • Message
  • Custom fields

Keep it simple and let your visitors contact you in just a few clicks.

Multi-Step Lead Forms

Need to collect more detailed information?

EasyLead lets you build multistep popup forms that guide visitors through a series of questions.

Example workflow:

  1. Choose a service
  2. Select a material
  3. Choose a location
  4. Add additional information
  5. Enter contact details
  6. Submit the inquiry

Each step can contain different fields, making it easy to build forms tailored to your business.

Features

  • Simple popup contact forms
  • Multistep lead forms
  • Unlimited form steps
  • Custom fields for every step
  • Fully customizable popup
  • Responsive design
  • Store every submission inside WordPress
  • Instant email notifications
  • Easy setup
  • No coding required
  • Lightweight and fast

Lead Management

Every submitted inquiry is automatically saved inside your WordPress dashboard.

View customer information, submitted answers, contact details, and inquiry history from one place.

Never lose a lead again.

Perfect For

EasyLead is perfect for:

  • Construction companies
  • Renovation businesses
  • Electricians
  • Plumbers
  • Cleaning services
  • Car workshops
  • Landscaping companies
  • Marketing agencies
  • Web agencies
  • Freelancers
  • Local service businesses
  • Any company collecting customer inquiries

Why EasyLead?

Visitors are more likely to complete forms that are simple and intuitive.

Use a single-step popup when you only need basic contact details, or create a guided multistep experience that collects everything you need before starting a conversation.

EasyLead helps you generate higher-quality leads while keeping every inquiry organized inside WordPress.

Support Development

EasyLead is completely free, and we plan to keep it that way.

If our plugins and open-source projects save you time or help your business, you can support future development by buying us a coffee using the button available inside the plugin.

Every contribution helps us maintain existing projects and create new free tools for the WordPress community.

Thank you for your support! ☕
sections.installation:
1. Upload the EasyLead plugin or install it from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open EasyLead from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Create your first popup form.
  5. Configure the popup appearance and fields.
  6. Publish the popup on your website.
sections.faq:
Can I create a simple contact form?

Yes. EasyLead allows you to create a standard popup contact form without multiple steps.

Can I create multistep forms?

Yes. You can build fully customized multistep forms with different fields for each step.

Where are submissions stored?

Every submission is saved inside the WordPress admin panel.

Will I receive email notifications?

Yes. EasyLead can notify you whenever a visitor submits a new inquiry.

Do I need coding skills?

No. Everything can be configured from the WordPress admin panel.

Is EasyLead free?

Yes. EasyLead is completely free to use. If you’d like to support future development of our free plugins and open-source projects, you can use the optional “Buy Me a Coffee” button available inside the plugin.
